strategy.name: NASDAQ Pullback (daily + hourly)
strategy.summary: Buys short dips in the NASDAQ 100 while it's in a long-term uptrend, sells on the bounce
rules: Only buy while NASDAQ's last daily close is above its 200-day average (no trades in downtrends)
Daily Pullback: buy at the next day's open when the 2-day RSI closes below 30 AND the day closed in the bottom half of its range; sell at the next open once RSI(2) rises above 70, or after 10 days
Hourly Pullback: buy at the next hour's open when the 2-hour RSI closes below 10; sell at the next open once an hour closes above its 5-hour average, or after 14 hours
Safety stop 6x ATR below entry; risk 0.75% of the starting balance per trade; one trade per strategy at a time
Safety switch: pauses a strategy at -8% account drawdown, or if after 20+ live trades its win rate drops below 50% or profit factor below 1.0
strategy.evidence: Daily: 25-year test, 67% / 76% wins (older / newer half). Hourly: ~3-year test, 66-67% wins in both halves
